phase_name: Gate Registry Schema, Shared Runner Library, and Migration of Gates 1-8

objectives.description: Define registry data shape on manifest-routing-lib.sh precedent
Add gate-registry-lib.sh: parse, resolve, execute one gate
Fold source-store guard into requires_source_store field
objectives.note: DEVIATION: requires_source_store is declared as ACCURATE metadata (true for gates 3,5,6,7,8; false for 1,2,4) but each gate's internal guard code is NOT removed/hoisted generically -- the 5 guarded gates' SKIP message shapes and check order are not uniform enough to fold losslessly without changing byte output (gate5's 2-line message; gate8's SKIP_SLOW-before-source-store order). Folding is recorded as a judged-unsafe scope narrowing for THIS phase, not a silent omission; see gate-registry.data's own requires_source_store field doc.

objectives.description: Migrate gates 1-8 onto registry; leave 9-23 legacy

objectives.note: stdout, stderr, and exit code (rc=1, matching known pre-existing gate3/gate4-citation findings) all byte-identical before vs. after.

deviations.description: Fold the repeated source-store-only guard into the requires_source_store registry field.
deviations.reason: The field is declared as accurate metadata, but the literal code-fold (removing each gate's own inline guard and generically rendering its SKIP message from the registry) was judged unsafe for byte-identical output: gate5's SKIP message is a genuinely different 2-line shape, and gate8 checks --skip-slow BEFORE source-store (a generic hoist would reorder these and change output when both conditions hold). Each function keeps its own internal guard, exactly as extracted from the pre-registry inline code.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered -- requires_source_store declared as metadata only, guard code not hoisted; see gate-registry.data field doc)*
